title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 tek Ali Demi, pranë Shkolles 1 Maji.

The area of ​​Ali Demi is quite sought after, quiet and with all facilities nearby (schools, markets, public transport). The price is in LEK. It is not given on credit
